newsitem.title: USA: DIANON Systems plans to boost 1997 EPS.
newsitem.headline: DIANON Systems plans to boost 1997 EPS.

text.p: DIANON Systems Inc said Thursday it had set itself a goal of raising earnings per share for 1997 to a range of $0.40 to $0.45.

"Our goal continues to be to increase earnings per share 20 (percent) to 30 (percent) per annum," it said. "Applying these targets to our 1996 earnings of $0.34 per share would suggest a range for 1997 earnings per of $0.40 to $0.45."
DIANON reported 1996 fourth-quarter earnings of $0.11 a share against $0.01 a year ago.
The company provides testing services to patients, physicians and managed care organizations.
